releaseNotes: v1.7.0: Choose which equipment Hubitat creates (Equipment page; deleted devices stay deleted). One Log level in the app for every device, with all logs under the app. Dark mode. Reconnects on its own if the controller goes quiet, and devices only change when a command was actually sent. Pump shows the running body's water temperature. Body devices get plain command names (old ones still work), and Heat Lock now covers every heat change. Salt cells reported by the controller get their own Chlorinator device. No Done needed: the Bridge switches over on its own within a minute.
author: jdthomas24

apps.name: Pentair IntelliCenter
apps.description: Connects to the IntelliCenter controller and lets you choose which equipment Hubitat creates.

drivers.name: Pentair IntelliCenter Bridge
drivers.description: Internal: holds the connection to the controller and creates the equipment devices. Created by the app.

drivers.name: Pentair IntelliCenter Body
drivers.description: Pool or spa: on/off, water temperature, set point, heat source and Heat Lock.

drivers.name: Pentair IntelliCenter Pump
drivers.description: Variable speed pump: RPM, GPM and watts, plus speed control.

drivers.name: Pentair IntelliCenter Chlorinator
drivers.description: IntelliChlor salt cell: salt level, pool and spa output and superchlorinate (read-only).
